title.narrative: To reduce HIV infections by 85%, new HIV infections among children by less than 4%, AIDS related deaths by 80% and HIV related stigma to 5%, all from 2010 baseline by 2025.

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic) - HIV - Ministry of Finance of the United Republic of Tanzania - MoF. This program has the following goals: To reduce new HIV infections by 75% in 2020, and by 85% in 2023. To reduce new HIV infections among children to less than 5% by 2023. To reduce AIDS related deaths by 50% in 2020 and 70% by the end of 2023. To reduce stigma and discrimination to 13.83% by 2023 from 25.60 in 2017. The objectives of this program are: To implement efficient testing strategies so that 95% of people living with HIV will know their status by 2022. To implement client centered ART care so that 95% of all people diagnosed with HIV are enrolled, followed up and receive timely and efficacious HAART by 2022. To optimize ART so that 95% of all people receiving ART will attain sustainable viral suppression by 2022. To increase percentage of women and men engaged in non-marital, non-cohabiting partner reporting use of a condom at last sexual intercourse to 50% by 2023 from 31.7% in 2017. To reduce the incidence of STIs in the general population and in pregnant women by 50% by 2023. To reduce the percentage of mother to child transmission at the end of breast feeding period, from an estimated 8% (in 2015), to 4% by the end of 2023. To reduce the burden of other HIV co-infections and co-morbidities amongst PLHIV by 50 percent of the 2016 level by 2022
